messages:
Priya (eng): Heads up — CI on the sampleapp onboarding flow is failing after yesterday's openapi formatting change. regen-diff shows a bunch of param reorderings in the generated clients.

Priya (eng): Minimal repro: run `yarn typegen:regen` in sampleapp and you get many diffs like:
```diff
- function createUser(opts?: { email?: string; name?: string })
+ function createUser(opts?: { name?: string; email?: string })
```

Jonas (sdk): Ugh, ordering-only diffs again. Is this the spec reformat or the typegen default sort change?

Priya (eng): Looks like a change in our openapi pre-processor: we now use `Object.entries()` in one pass which is non-deterministic for some YAML loads. I can reproduce locally if I run `node scripts/normalize-openapi.js`.

CI Bot: build/sampleapp-regendiff #478 failed — 45 changed files, 312 changed lines. See https://ci.internal/reports/478

Aisha (devex): This will block the release publish if we don't treat it as a patch vs minor diff. Right now the changed shape is purely parameter order (no type/shape changes). Suggest two options: 1) force stable sort in pre-processor, 2) add a regen-tolerance step to CI that normalizes ordering before diff.

Marta (docs): Also worth noting: changelog tooling reads `typegen` output to auto-generate examples. If order flips, our examples in docs show different param order which causes sampleapp tests to fail. We should avoid churn in examples.

Jonas (sdk): Quick patch: I'll open a PR to apply stable sort to operation/object keys in `normalize-openapi.js`. Patch will be small. But rolling that out will flip existing generated hashes — we need to decide if we accept the bump as a patch or keep semver untouched.

Priya (eng): For the short term can we pin the published typegen artifact used by sampleapp to previous hash? That'd unblock the sampleapp CI while we land the stable-sort fix.

Aisha (devex): Pinning is fine as emergency mitigation, but we should add a CI gate that runs `npm pack` + `yarn add file:...` in a sandboxed job so publishes aren't blocked by transient regen diffs.

Jonas (sdk): Agreed. I'll do: add stable sort PR today, and a small CI job to `yarn typegen:regen && git status --porcelain` and fail only if there are semantic changes (we can diff with `--word-diff` and grep for type/enum changes).

Priya (eng): I'll open the pin PR for sampleapp now and attach the CI logs. @Jonas can you link your stable-sort PR here when ready so I can remove the pin?

Marta (docs): Also create a tiny changelog entry describing the non-user-facing ordering normalization so release notes don't claim a behavior change. 

CI Bot: Note — publishing pipeline blocked by `regendiff` mismatch: release/canary job paused.

Aisha (devex): Can someone volunteer to write the changelog snippet? 1-2 lines is enough. I'll coordinate the canary hold until we confirm parity. :pray:

Jonas (sdk): I'll write it. PR link when ready (WIP).

Priya (eng): TY. PRs incoming: 1) sampleapp pin, 2) stable-sort + regen acceptance job. Will post diffs shortly.

Marta (docs): Thanks — will hold off on pushing docs examples until both land. :white_check_mark:
